l_farmers.speaker: LUCIEN
lines: You know the line pays the farmers who hid you? Quietly, after. It is the honour of the thing. So — where did you come down? A village, a field, anything; I match it to the ledger and someone's courage becomes bread.
A gentle question, for the ledger: where did the sky put you? The line pays the houses that opened. A parish, a road, a beet field — any thread, and I can see the right pocket is filled.

choices.text: Pay every farm in Picardy, then. I never asked the parish.
North of a river. There was a barn. It was dark.
A beet field near a farm — the family had a boy, Luc. They earned it.

l_crash_deflect.speaker: LUCIEN
lines: Every farm in Picardy! You are a philanthropist. All right, all right — the ledger stays thin and the courage stays anonymous. It is more elegant that way, if less nourishing.
Ha — pay the whole north, why not. You give like a bishop, my friend. Fine: anonymous courage. The purest kind, and the cheapest for me.

l_crash_vague.speaker: LUCIEN
lines: A river, a barn, the dark. My friend, you describe France. No matter — the ledger has heard vaguer and paid anyway.
North of a river! There are four rivers and nine hundred barns. Poetic and useless — like most true things. The ledger will cope.

l_crash_reveal.speaker: LUCIEN
lines: A boy called Luc — how good you are with the details. The ledger loves details; they are how the right family gets the right bread. Consider their courage… banked.
Near a beet field, a family, a boy Luc. Perfect. Exactly what the ledger wants — precision is kindness, you see. They will be looked after, monsieur. Personally.
